message: おもいで風景
It's a holiday, but since it's the day before the Holy Night Festival, there are quite a few people around.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Nanaka? Oh, Nanaka Yugiri-san. Nope, haven't seen her!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Sorry I couldn't be of help!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, thank you for taking the time while you're busy!」
Come to think of it, when we first saw this place.
Nanaka said something about it looking like the Palace of Versailles.
Even though neither of us had ever seen an actual palace.

name: Eddie
message: 「Yugiri? Haven't seen her around. More importantly, check out this crossdressing outfit! Looks pretty good on me, right?」
No way she'd be here, huh.
I check inside Nanaka's desk just in case.
Textbooks and... this is a test... Hrmm.
She hasn't changed at all since we were little.
Can't be helped.
Just like always, let's pretend I didn't see this.

name: Synn
message: 「Guess she wouldn't come here」
Come to think of it, Nanaka did come here with Sacchin once.
Did she borrow something, I wonder?
I did combat training with Nanaka here, didn't I.
Well, technically, it was with everyone.
I feel like I paired up with Nanaka a lot of the time.
Come to think of it, when we first enrolled.
We talked about gathering fallen leaves here when autumn came and roasting the sweet potatoes grown in my yard, didn't we.
We haven't done it this year either. Not yet, anyway. She is the Student Council President, after all.
I wonder if Nanaka remembers?
Nanaka is actually pretty good at swimming.
Back in the day, she even got a perfect attendance award at the summer vacation swimming classes held at the community center.
She came to pick me up every day, and since I tagged along, I ended up getting a perfect attendance award too.
The watermelon we were treated to at Nanaka's house on the way back was chilled and delicious.
I guess it's too open here to hide.
We attended Sunday service once, didn't we.
Even though she dragged me along, Nanaka fell asleep first.
Though I was tired from my part-time job and fell asleep too.
Both of us ended up getting woken up by Tame-san.
Setup for the Holy Night Festival stage seems to be progressing steadily.

name: Yumil
message: 「Morning, Sakura-senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning. Have you seen Nanaka?」

name: Yumil
message: 「No, I haven't seen her today. Maybe she's still asleep at home?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Yumil
message: 「It's already tomorrow, so she's probably gearing up for an all-nighter to finish preparations. Oops, I can't say any more than that.」
A secret, huh. A surprise for the Holy Night Festival.

name: Synn
message: 「If you see Nanaka, please contact me on this phone.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Got it. There's nothing to worry about, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why's that?」

name: Yumil
message: 「She'll definitely show up for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That Soba girl must've left the academy grounds. I'm sure of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「It seems that way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, if she were on campus, someone would've spotted her. It's the day before the Holy Night Festival, after all.」
I also told everyone I know to let the Student Council know if they see Nanaka.
For now, it looks like there's nothing more I can do at the academy.
Even so,
to think the two of us would end up attending the very academy whose gate we scribbled graffiti on when we were little--well, more like I was forced to do it.
You really never know what's going to happen in life.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin', Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Sacchin. Did you happen to see Nanaka?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, haven't seen her! I just got here myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
Guess they didn't pass each other on the way to school either.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it be... Synn-kun, did you confess your feelings to Nana-chan?!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat?! No, it's nothing like that, I mean, h-h-how did you even jump to that conclusion?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's no use hiding it! When it actually happened, Nana-chan got scared and ran away, didn't she? What a handful!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds plausible enough to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't worry, Synn-kun! It's not like she rejected you! Nana-chan's just a total chicken!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it'd be nice if you actually listened to what I have to say once in a while.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You'll get your answer on the day of the Holy Night Festival~ I mean, after I helped out so much, if Nana-chan chickens out~, I'm gonna be super mad~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin! Listen to me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. Those are some serious eyes~ Still, no fair confessing to me~ You'll put me in a tough spot~」

name: Synn
message: 「As if I would!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you spot Nanaka, contact the Student Council or call this cell phone」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Roger~ Oh, this is a girl's phone~ Synn-kun, you two-timer~」

name: Synn
message: 「I only borrowed it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's what all guys say~」

name: Paqy
message: 「All guys are cheaters. Though yours truly only has eyes for Ria-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Just contact me, okay!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Got it~ I think she'll be fine, though~ Nana-chan will definitely show up on the day of the Holy Night Festival~」

name: Synn
message: 「Okamoto-san said something like that too, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah~ then again, running away when it counts is pretty much like Nana-chan too, I guess~」

name: Synn
message: 「Which is it?」
When we walked to school together this morning, I never imagined things would turn out like this.
Nanaka was full of energy. Not looking sleep-deprived at all.
No different from how she always is.
Always, huh.
The "always" I thought had never changed since way back when.
Listening to Nanaka recap TV dramas, checking each other's homework.
Even almost being late because we chased after a cat…….
It's not past tense. It'll keep going from here on out too.

name: Synn
message: 「She's not here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「A long time ago. An old lady who used to give us candy lived right here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talking about ancient history now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... They were Kanro candies. Nanaka used to give me her share all the time.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a nice story.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh... Classic Soba. She was already feeding you to wrap you around her finger back then? Terrifying.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Please stop twisting the past too.」
She's not here.
...Back then.
In this park.
I was always stuck playing the girl kidnapped by the monster...
And Nanaka was always the one who came to the rescue.
And then I'd get stuck playing the monster who gets beat up too...

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Morning, saw Nanaka. Noon, don't see.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Thanks. If you spot her, let me know.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, eat.」
A beef bowl was placed in front of me. And it's a large serving.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good. I still have a lot of places I need to go.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Don't eat. Collapse. Can't do anything.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then I'll--」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you, Eauderourke.」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no way she'd be here, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, there are a lot of familiar faces around here, so someone might've at least seen her...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh, if it ain't Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Have you seen Nanaka?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Nope, somethin' happen?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you see Nanaka, please call this cell number. I'm begging you.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「...Got it. I won't pry into the details. Leave it to me. I'll put the word out to the folks around here too」

name: Synn
message: 「And one more thing」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Don't worry. I'll make sure Auntie Shina doesn't find out」

name: Synn
message: 「I owe you one」

name: Tame-san
message: 「If Auntie Shina found out Synn was all flustered because his young wife ran off on him, her eyes'd light right up and she'd raise a huge ruckus」

name: Tame-san
message: 「You're not gonna deny it like you always do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone around here has always made jokes like that, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Do we really... um... well... look like we're in that kind of relationship?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「So even Synn's finally starting to care about it! Guess it paid off to keep bringing it up」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha. Ah, youth! Youth! Good, good!」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So Nanaka hasn't come back」
By whatever means, it seems Sally had already gotten in touch with him.

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. I'll find her. Definitely」
Feeling as though we had made eye contact, I looked over,
『Synn. Did something happen with Nanaka?』
His eyes were dead serious. I took a single deep breath before asking.
『Uncle. Are you a demon?』
Come to think of it, the Demon Lord can speak with demons. And I can communicate with Uncle like this.
Plus, Uncle can also communicate with Tinun and Jangara.
『Don't tell me... Nanaka's traits have manifested?』
I gave a small nod.
『Why... Half-demons... aren't supposed to manifest demon traits...』
I see. So Uncle is a demon, and Auntie is human.
『Is that how it works?』
『Unless those traits are forcibly dragged out...』
『Just the other day, someone named Melilot came and removed the hex that had been placed on Nanaka's bed... Why』
It all connected.
Mr. Sengenin's home visit. That really was when it was planted.
It probably has something to do with that dream.
Whatever that thing was, it had been dragging out Nanaka's demon traits little by little.
Melilot-san must have taken some kind of measure, which is why she told me it would be fine, yet it was already too late.
I looked at the older man with determination.
『I'll definitely find Nanaka. And we'll come back here together』
『...I'm counting on you』
『Please don't worry. They say the Demon Lord saves the world, and if I can't even find Nanaka, there's no way I could save the world』

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san? She hasn't come in today」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Besides, today is the day before the Holy Night Festival. Shouldn't the Student Council members be at the academy?」

name: Synn
message: 「...She hasn't arrived yet」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Judging from how you look, you've naturally already checked with her parents' home, and tried her cell phone as well, haven't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Do you have any idea where she might be?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「When it comes to Nanaka-san, I believe Sakura-san would know much more than I do」

name: Synn
message: 「...It's not like I know everything about her」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「If I happen to see Nanaka-san, I will be sure to contact you」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「The Holy Night Festival is still going ahead as scheduled tomorrow, yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In that case, I believe everything will be fine」

name: Synn
message: 「...Are you saying Nanaka will definitely show up?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. Because Nanaka-san was resolved to stake everything on the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Resolved?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I cannot say any more than that」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「She hasn't come by today」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I'll give you a call if she shows up. Did something happen between you two?」

name: Synn
message: 「...How should I put it. It's not that anything happened between us. No, maybe it's because I couldn't say what I needed to say...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...Couldn't say what you needed to say, huh」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Regret is truly a bitter thing」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I've only just now come to understand my father's greatness and the true depth of sweets. I feel like I'm finally standing at the starting line as a pastry chef」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「If my father saw me as I am now, I think he'd smile wryly and say, 'Took you until that age to finally get there?'--yet still be happy for me」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「But my father is no longer here... I can't show him how I am now, nor can I have him taste the sweets I'm making today」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「However, you still have time. If there's something you truly need to say, you just have to keep trying to convey it until it gets through」
She's not here.
I wanted to ask Shio-chan, but she's nowhere to be seen--maybe she went to the academy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama. Didn't the two of you used to play around here when you were kids?」

name: Synn
message: 「We played here a lot」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then you remember the secret spots where you used to hide and play back then, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are a bunch, but... first, let's check the cave behind the shrine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... As expected of Synn-sama. Playing some kinky doctor game away from prying eyes, huh? Truly a master of eros」

name: Synn
message: 「We never played doctor」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, no sense of romance at all」

name: Synn
message: 「We played explorers, or... soba shop」

name: Paqy
message: 「With Synn-sama as the customer?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka was the master, and I was the apprentice. She'd scold me if I didn't put my back into it」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's weirdly realistic」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure it was right here」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been sealed up」
The slope had been paved over with concrete, leaving no trace that a cave had ever been there.

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's check the next spot, next」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah」

name: Paqy
message: 「You didn't ride that thing either」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... well, I didn't think I'd ride it at this point anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「Locals ride it until they're sick of it from a young age, what with school events and little family outings」

name: Paqy
message: 「Haven't you ever come here alone with Soba or anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I've never done something like a date like that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, though for Master Synn, the boarding fee is a bottleneck」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there was just one time」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba's treat?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not open to the general public, but there's a day when locals can board for free. Nanaka suddenly said she wanted to ride it」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Even on the free admission day, locals hardly ever come, so nobody was there」

name: Paqy
message: 「A day when nobody's there, huh... Master Synn sure is dense」

name: Synn
message: 「I really am dense, aren't I...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what happened?」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently, when that ship was in active service, it was a passenger liner on a round-the-world route」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's what it said on the info board」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka said she'd love to spend about a year going on a world sweets tour on a ship like this」

name: Paqy
message: 「And?」

name: Synn
message: 「She said going around alone would be boring, so she'd take me along too」

name: Paqy
message: 「What did you reply?」

name: Synn
message: 「I said I'd feel bad if Nanaka paid for everything, so I'd be fine with it once I start earning money」

name: Paqy
message: 「You answered lightly anyway, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, because I thought it was just casual banter...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I feel sorry for Soba too」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, for some reason, Nanaka got all flustered. She asked if I was really okay with it being just the two of us for a whole year, so I told her I'd be fine if it's with her.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And you probably answered that without thinking twice, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I genuinely thought I'd be fine as long as it was Nanaka.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sigh... Man, I really feel sorry for her.」
I understand now.
I only answered that way because it was Nanaka.
If it hadn't been Nanaka, I'm sure I never would've said I'd be fine with just the two of us.

name: Synn
message: 「Where could she have gone...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, President. Looking around restlessly like that, people might mistake you for a burglar, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you're looking for Nanaka, I haven't seen her around.」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see」
She must have heard from Ria-senpai.

name: Misasagi
message: 「No luck for you either, President? I even bought enough for her, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We've finished up our preparations and had some free time, so I thought I'd bring some refreshments to the Student Council.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's something I'd like a quick word with you about--do you have a moment?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Say, did you see them? Those bright red eyes of hers.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How do you know about that!? Oh, Ria-senpai must've」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Riya didn't say a word.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yesterday morning, Nanaka was having a terrible nightmare, you see.」
Come to think of it, I heard she stayed over at Misasagi-senpai's house.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I could have just left her be, but she looked to be in so much pain that I couldn't help taking pity on her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you wake her up?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right. When I asked her, 'What happened to your eyes? Did you put chili pepper eye drops in them or something?' she got terribly frightened, saying, 'I was seen, I was seen.'」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She made me promise over and over not to tell anyone.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In particular, it seems she didn't want you to find out, President.」
It's the same.
Just like how I didn't want anyone--especially Nanaka--to find out that I'm the Demon Lord.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even when I told her to go see a doctor, she refused, and it seemed she didn't want Sacchin to find out either.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I didn't really understand why, but I figured it wouldn't be good if outsiders saw her like that. So I told her to calm down for now, had her drink some tea with sleeping medicine in it, and put her to sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「That happened... What did Sacchin say about it?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「When I told her that Nanaka hadn't been getting enough sleep lately so I forced her to rest, she accepted it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She probably thought that if you saw her, President, you'd call her a monster. Even without that wild eye color, she's already a sweets yokai anyway. A bit late to worry about that now.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Say, President. When you saw those eyes, did you call her a monster?」

name: Synn
message: 「...In the heat of the moment, the words wouldn't come out.」
Back then.
If only I had said what I needed to say.
If only I had told her, 'Nanaka is still Nanaka.'

name: Misasagi
message: 「You aren't to blame, President. If an old acquaintance suddenly turned out looking strange, anyone would be bewildered.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Jumping to conclusions before hearing a proper answer and immediately backing down--that's that girl's bad habit, being so overly sensitive and timid.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's true that Soba is cowardly and lacks pushiness.」
Nanaka, cowardly. Lacking pushiness.
If it were me from just a little while ago, I probably would have thought those were the words furthest removed from Nanaka.
But.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, so you really did see her, President. If you hadn't, I could have reassured you by saying she'll be back in time for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone keeps saying Nanaka will definitely come to the Holy Night Festival, so what's going on?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, I am a blabbermouth, and I'm neither a companion of hers nor a regular at Yuugiri-an, so telling you wouldn't count as a betrayal.」
Misasagi-senpai grinned.

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, my, you're quite the cruel person, aren't you, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--?! Why do you say that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That timid little Nanaka screwed up all her courage--as if leaping off the stage at Kiyomizu--and spent a whole month preparing this in secret, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't you think making me spill the beans so you can find out ahead of time and ruin her plans goes against basic human decency?」

name: Synn
message: 「...You have no intention of telling me, do you?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm saying I wouldn't mind telling you, aren't I?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pass.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then hurry up and find her, and see for yourself on the day of.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good answer. It seems Nanaka's fears were completely unfounded. Here you are searching desperately for her, President.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you thought she was a monster, you'd only go looking for her if there were a bounty on her head.」

name: Synn
message: 「When I see her, I wonder if I'll be able to talk to her properly...」
What if I end up stammering again. And what if Nanaka runs away.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wouldn't know. You're the one who has to speak up, President, not me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's got a point.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Once you find her, make sure you catch her good and tight so she can't get away.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll catch her for sure.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, could you pass along a message for me while you're at it? Tell her, 'You haven't even served me soba good enough to blow me away yet--are you really planning to disappear just like that?'」
And before I knew it, the sun had set.
I kept searching for Nanaka.
Even though the Holy Night Festival is tomorrow.
Even though I'm the one in charge of the Holy Night Festival.
Even though the world might end tomorrow.
Even so, I'm still looking for Nanaka.
Because it's something only I can do.
Because it's something I have to do.
Because I have a feeling Nanaka wouldn't want anyone other than me to find her.
There were memories of Nanaka everywhere I looked.
Even though every single one of them was trivial.
I felt like Nanaka could be anywhere.
I wonder since when.
That I started searching for Nanaka.
I wonder since when.
That Nanaka couldn't be found anymore.
That was.
Maybe ever since the moment we shared our first kiss.
That was.
Or maybe it had been like this ever since the very first time we met.
Nanaka wasn't a childhood friend who never kept any secrets from me.
I had finally come to realize that.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello」

name: Ria
message: 「How's it going, Synn-kun?」
It didn't seem like they'd heard any news on their end either.

name: Synn
message: 「...Nothing yet」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... Sorry we can't all look for her together」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm the one who should apologize for not helping prepare for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine. Anyone can pitch in to save the world, but you're the only one who can find Nanaka-chan, Synn-kun」
I hope she's right.
What if I never get to see Nanaka again...
I felt an ache deep in my chest.

name: Ria
message: 「You'll be fine. If it's you, Synn-kun, I know you'll find Nanaka-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll bring Nanaka back tomorrow」

name: Ria
message: 「Tomorrow won't cut it」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Ria
message: 「It's already the 24th, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'll definitely make it in time」

name: Ria
message: 「Good, good. That's the spirit」

name: Ria
message: 「Do your best. I'll be waiting in the Student Council room」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're so inconsiderate, Synn-sama. That was my beloved Ria-chan on the line, so put me on too」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. It slipped my mind」

name: Paqy
message: 「When you answer all seriously like that, it kinda throws me off」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, though. Even if we're gonna look for her, where else is left to search?」
What if I can't find her. What do I do if I can't see her.
Don't think about it. I'll definitely find her. Definitely.

name: Synn
message: 「...Maybe we just missed each other」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, but I asked around with a bunch of guys in the shopping district. If we still haven't found her, shouldn't we assume she left town?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, it's almost 2 AM. Nobody's gonna be out looking at this hour」
Right. It's already the day of the Holy Night Festival.
If I can't see her like this...
Thinking that sends a pain deep into my chest, like an ice pick being driven in.
No. No. I don't want that.
I won't let this end in regret!

name: Paqy
message: 「Even when old man Amakawa starts his milk route--and he's the earliest riser around--it'll already be too late」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is there seriously nowhere else? Nowhere the two of you used to hang out?」

name: Synn
message: 「...There's just one place left」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where?」
